selection: fixed final 20000 per arm; preserve every evaluation; no validation-best, budget, learning-rate or threshold fitting
method: frozen source RootLocalizer64; trainable per-frame Conv2d(256+XYgrid->32,k3) ReLU; temporal Conv3d(32->32,k5x3x3) ReLU; zero-initialized keys Conv2d32->64; frozen source query applies residual logits added to source center logits; unchanged heatmap softmax and coordinate expectation; AdamW constant0.0003
contrast: center repeats center feature five times; ordered uses original[-2,-1,0,+1,+2]; identical initial weights, parameters, seed, center sampling, targets and update budget; zero residual initially reproduces source exactly
context_policy: offline reconstruction permits two future frames; no match or clip crossing; first two and last two source frames unscored without padding
targets: original verified float64 projected pixels and boolean inside-image active-root masks; no state inputs, relabeling, offsets or root repulsion
loss: unchanged bilinear root heatmap cross entropy over original eligible player roots
tracking_proxy: among frames with both original roots eligible, alternative player assignment lowers joint Euclidean error by at least16pixels; diagnostic proxy only, not proof of swapped identities or corrected occlusion
source_status: frozen expanded source passed development gates but failed strict training sanity; no automatic controller promotion
review_selection: first four sorted validation clip IDs; all1200 original frames at60FPS; first/lasttwo tracking-boundary frames explicitly unscored
